turns.assessment: The initiating event is the EQPT_TX_FAIL alarm on the S08 end of och125, simultaneous with LOS at the S15 receiver and both affected services going down. Loss of och125 channel power at every downstream monitor, while amplifier telemetry remains unchanged, localizes the failure to the channel transmitter rather than the fibre or shared amplification path. A card failure is less likely because there is no evidence that the S08 receiver side or the whole unit failed.

proposals.rationale: The S08 interface raised EQPT_TX_FAIL, and the far-end S15 interface immediately reported OCH_LOS, lost receive power, OSNR, and BER validity. Downstream OCMs lost only this channel while amplifiers showed no power or pump changes, matching loss of the S08 transmit laser.

A failed S08 line-interface card could also remove its transmitted channel, but it should additionally disable the receive side and silence its monitoring; the available S08 receiver metrics did not change.
